subject: en_guided
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 1 (Year 1 reading comprehension), taught through VIPERS guided reading skills (vocabulary, infer, predict, explain, retrieve, sequence)

weeks.topic: Introducing guided reading: title, author and illustrator
objectives: Find the title, author and illustrator
Hold a book and track print from left to right

weeks.topic: Retrieve: who and where in a picture book
objectives: Find who is in the story
Find where the story happens

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: talking about new words in a story
objectives: Spot a new word and ask what it means
Use pictures to help work out meaning

weeks.topic: Predict: using the cover and title
objectives: Say what might happen from the cover
Give a reason for my prediction

weeks.topic: Sequence: ordering pictures from a familiar story
objectives: Put story pictures in order
Retell the story using the pictures

weeks.topic: Infer: how does the character feel?
objectives: Use faces in pictures to work out feelings
Say how I know

weeks.topic: Explain: why I like this book
objectives: Say what I like about a book
Give a reason using because

weeks.topic: Retrieve: answering what questions
objectives: Find answers to what questions in a short text
Point to the words that show the answer

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: rhyming words in a poem
objectives: Find words that rhyme
Talk about favourite sound words

weeks.topic: Predict: using clues in the pictures
objectives: Look at pictures to predict what happens next
Check if I was right

weeks.topic: Sequence: first, next, then, finally — a traditional tale
objectives: Retell a traditional tale with time words
Order the main events

weeks.topic: Infer: why did the character do that?
objectives: Talk about the reasons for a character's actions
Use clues from the words and pictures

weeks.topic: Retrieve: facts in a non-fiction text
objectives: Find one fact in a non-fiction book
Read captions and labels

weeks.topic: Explain: what the title tells us
objectives: Talk about why a story has its title
Think of another title

weeks.topic: Review: guided reading skills from Term 1
objectives: Practise retrieving, predicting and sequencing
Answer questions about a short story

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: words that describe a character
objectives: Find describing words for a character
Choose new words to describe them

weeks.topic: Retrieve: when and where questions
objectives: Find when and where events happen
Use the words in the text to answer

weeks.topic: Predict: what will the character say?
objectives: Predict a character's words
Use what I know about the character

weeks.topic: Sequence: ordering sentences from a story
objectives: Put sentences from a story in order
Read them back to check they make sense

weeks.topic: Infer: actions show feelings
objectives: Work out feelings from what a character does
Explain using the text

weeks.topic: Explain: comparing two characters
objectives: Say how two characters are the same and different
Give reasons

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: words that mean the same
objectives: Find words with similar meanings
Swap a word for a similar one

weeks.topic: Retrieve: labels, captions and diagrams
objectives: Find facts in a labelled diagram
Answer questions using captions

weeks.topic: Predict: a different ending
objectives: Imagine a different ending
Say why it could happen

weeks.topic: Sequence: retelling a life cycle
objectives: Order the stages of a frog's life cycle
Use time words to retell it

weeks.topic: Infer: what is the character thinking?
objectives: Write a thought bubble for a character
Use clues in the story

weeks.topic: Mid-year guided reading check
objectives: Answer retrieval and sequencing questions
Make a simple prediction

weeks.topic: Explain: linking a story to my own life
objectives: Talk about a time something similar happened to me
Compare it with the story

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: interesting verbs (stomp, creep, dash)
objectives: Find interesting action words
Act them out to show meaning

weeks.topic: Retrieve: answers in a short poem
objectives: Find words in a poem to answer questions
Read the poem aloud

weeks.topic: Predict: using what I know about fairy tales
objectives: Use what usually happens in fairy tales to predict
Explain my thinking

weeks.topic: Infer: clues about the setting
objectives: Work out where and when a story happens
Use clues in the pictures and words

weeks.topic: Sequence: summarising a story in three sentences
objectives: Tell the beginning, middle and end
Use one sentence for each part

weeks.topic: Explain: giving reasons for my opinion
objectives: Say if I liked a book and why
Listen to others' opinions

weeks.topic: Checking the text makes sense and self-correcting
objectives: Re-read when a word does not make sense
Correct my own mistakes

weeks.topic: End-of-year guided reading assessment
objectives: Answer questions using all VIPERS skills
Read a new text with support

weeks.topic: Year 1 review: VIPERS skills
objectives: Revisit vocabulary, inference, prediction and retrieval
Share a favourite guided reading book
